verdicts.file: Achadh an Marbh-Annaghmare Court Tomb. Annaghmare TD, Crossmaglen - geograph.org.uk - 4172647.jpg
verdicts.note: Kerbed cairn with large upright orthostats on a grassy mound between conifers: the court tomb's own megalithic structure.

verdicts.file: Visitors car park at Achadh an Marbh-Annaghmare Court Tomb - geograph.org.uk - 4172658.jpg
verdicts.note: Site car park and green gate in the foreground; the tomb's stone cairn is clearly visible on the rise behind the gate.

verdicts.file: Remnant of the cairn cover of the Achadh na Marbh Court Tomb, Annaghmare - geograph.org.uk - 4173489.jpg
verdicts.note: Scattered kerb stones and cairn remains strewn over a grassy mound beside a woodland path: the tomb's own surviving remains.
